title: Collapsed messages are 36 pt rows under hairlines; focus is a soft plate
steps: Launch Mail with -UseFakeData; open a conversation with 4 or more messages
Move the pointer over a collapsed message, then over 'N older messages'
Press Up and Down to focus collapsed and open messages
Press R, then open Send later with the collapsed rows in view; then switch View › Appearance to Dark
expected: Collapsed messages are flat rows on the background (sender, snippet, date) with a thin line above each; senders line up with the subject and the open message's monogram. 'N older messages' starts at the same edge. Hover tints a row and nothing moves. The focused message has a rounded plate behind its row or header; there are no cards or accent bars. Same in Dark.
